description: Rectangle plus triangle meeting exactly along one edge. Tests alignment between two shapes of different kinds.
prompt: On a 200x200 pixel canvas filled with sky blue (#87ceeb), draw a house: a filled brown (#8b4513) rectangle 100 pixels wide and 80 pixels tall with its top-left corner at (50, 100), and above it a filled dark red (#b22222) triangular roof with vertices at (40, 100), (160, 100) and (100, 40). Coordinates are in pixels measured from the top-left corner of the canvas, with x increasing to the right and y increasing downwards.
